$comment: Daily quests, three a day: one easy, one medium, one hard, on a 24-hour reset. Taken from 99 Nights in the Forest, which added exactly this and climbed. `metric` is a counter quests.js keeps for the day; `goal` is how much of it. Add a quest by adding a row — but only using a metric already in the list, or the loader will refuse it.
$metrics: orbs (collected today), duelsWon, duelsFought, metres (walked), valleys (finished), perfectValleys (in 1-7 order), flawlessValleys (no duel lost), fastValleys (under eight minutes), bestCampBeaten (highest tier beaten today)

quests.text: Beat a camp at orb five or higher
Finish a valley in perfect order
Finish a valley without losing a duel
Finish a valley in under eight minutes
Beat the camp at orb seven
